system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
You no longer push against the world's resistances. They simply do not apply to you.

At Bulwark Initiation 16, both poles of your inevitability harden:

  • Ruin bypass. Damage from your offensive Surge spends (Erupt, Shatter, Cataclysm, Catastrophic Entry) ignores all kinetic resistance and any cover or structure damage reduction the target would otherwise apply. Energy and sephirotic resistances still apply.

  • Frame absorption. When Absorb or Brace Wall reduces incoming damage, reduce it by your Violence value first. (GM applies.)
